title: Reading and Writing Numbers 0 to 20
seo_title: Kindergarten Reading and Writing Numbers 0 to 20 Worksheets (TEKS K.2B)
standard_text: K.2B read, write, and represent whole numbers from 0 to at least 20 with and without objects or pictures
meta_desc: Free kindergarten number worksheets for Texas TEKS K.2B: read and write numbers 0 to 20, match numbers to pictures and number words. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: A number tells how many. 0 means none.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A number tells how many.
  • 0 means none.
  • Teen numbers start with 1: 12 is ten and two more.
  • Number words: one, two, three … twenty.

Examples

Example

How many dots? 8 dots

Count: 1 to 8

Answer: 8

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up 6 and 96 has its circle at the bottom.
Writing 12 as 21Teen numbers start with 1.
Forgetting 00 means there are none.
